provenance.representation: Source-backed readable repair of the existing technical TEI; original package and authorities conserved. No whole-body additive inverse is claimed.
provenance.rights_notice: Historical edition text is separate from Wikisource contributor transcription. Unless the page explicit license template says otherwise, contributor text is dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL; retain attribution and ShareAlike requirements. Do not treat transcription license as blanket rights clearance.
provenance.scope: One source-titled retained Wikisource electronic witness of The slave trade of east Africa (Church Missionary Society, 1869): one exact 92-record XML export, its root/Index context, 23 scan-page wikitext records 5 through 27, 67 retained support records and all XML metadata. Root main-transclusion reading excludes noinclude, uses retained template-defined fullword endings, and conserves notes, links and cross-page quotation context. Appendix/Notes A-C, Index dash positions and absent Page records stay qualified; no complete print-witness claim.

source_quality.interpretation: Source wording and typographical surprises retained; no scan comparison.
